Package org.a2aproject.sdk.compat03.conversion.mappers.domain

Interface TaskStatusMapper_v0_3

All Known Implementing Classes:
TaskStatusMapper_v0_3Impl
public interface TaskStatusMapper_v0_3
Bidirectional mapper for converting TaskStatus between A2A Protocol v0.3 and v1.0.

Both versions are records with the same structure: TaskStatus(TaskState state, Message message, OffsetDateTime timestamp).

The conversion involves:

  • Converting TaskState_v0_3 to TaskState (enum prefix mapping)
  • Converting Message_v0_3 to Message (class ↔ record)
  • Preserving the timestamp field (same type in both versions)
